nc.description: A glowing white cylinder extends through the center of a grey, treaded ring and curved structural elements resting on an angled base.

A 3D rendering shows a cross-section of a mechanical component featuring three internal pill-shaped elements, three prongs protruding from the left, and a rod terminating in a flat disc extending to the right.
A light grey 3D model of an abstract, planet-like object featuring a faceted central body, a segmented equatorial band, and two intersecting outer rings is displayed against a white background.
A light grey 3D rendering shows a mechanical gripper with curved prongs extending from a cylindrical collar mounted on parallel rails and resting on a support stand.
An assortment of grey, three-dimensional geometric shapes with various forms and textures is arranged on a white background around a central, glowing, faceted object.

vc.description: A mechanical track system features a central cylindrical actuator extending downward to engage with the internal linkage arms.
A mechanical assembly featuring jointed rods, linear guide rails, and a belt-driven pulley system is shown with its large wheel spinning.
A monochromatic mechanical assembly features a central textured shaft engaged with a roller chain and toothed belts.

A monochromatic 3D rendering displays an assortment of mechanical automotive parts, including a gear assembly, a drive shaft with universal joints, a steering rack, and shock absorbers, arranged against a plain white background.
Various grey mechanical components, including pipes, extrusions, and fasteners, are arranged in a radiating circular pattern around a central joint assembly on a white background.
